recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13133 unless the work group later wants a broader rewrite to harmonize extension availability, publication, package, and registry guidance across the extensibility pages.
issue_request: FHIR-13133 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core. It requested guidance that extension StructureDefinitions be available to consumers of instances; the final resolution used SHOULD-level language and listed direct canonical URL resolvability and/or publication in a known available registry as preferred mechanisms.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN revision 12861, represented in git as b5453f3f590385139315826a806e7f976349715c (#13133 - clarify about extensions). That commit added the current source/extensibility.html list item saying extension structure definitions SHOULD be available to consumers and naming canonical URL resolvability or registry publication as preferred approaches.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility.html, and source/hierarchy.xml includes Extensibility and Defining Extensions in the active navigation. source/extensibility.html still preserves the FHIR-13133 wording. Later FHIR-16989 clarified publication versus registry advertising on source/defining-extensions.html and is already represented on the combined branch; that later guidance complements the seed by explaining publication mechanics and registry optionality rather than reversing the availability expectation. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was necessary because the active source already implements the seed decision and further prose would be redundant.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue clarifying that publishing an extension definition and advertising it in a registry are not synonymous; it is already represented on the combined branch and supports leaving FHIR-13133 unchanged.
